ot / "abc_area_delay_formal_evidence.json"
    if not area_path.is_file() or not formal_path.is_file():
        raise TimingEvidenceError("ABC area-delay and formal manifests are required")

    contract = _load_contract(timing_contract.resolve())
    executable = _resolve_executable(sta)
    tool = _load_tool_metadata(tool_metadata.resolve(), executable, contract)
    area, formal = _validate_sources(area_path, formal_path)
    liberty, technology_config, technology_id = _technology_inputs(
        area_root,
        area,
        formal,
        contract,
    )
    analyses = _collect_analyses(area_root, area, formal)

    technology_dir = output / "technology"
    tooling_dir = output / "tooling"
    technology_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tooling_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    preserved_liberty = technology_dir / "technology.lib"
    preserved_technology = technology_dir / "technology.json"
    preserved_contract = output / "timing_contract.json"
    preserved_area = output / "source_abc_area_delay_evidence.json"
    preserved_formal = output / "source_abc_area_delay_formal_evidence.json"
    preserved_tool = tooling_dir / "tool.json"
    preserved_binary = tooling_dir / "opensta.bin"
    shutil.copyfile(liberty, preserved_liberty)
    shutil.copyfile(technology_config, preserved_technology)
    shutil.copyfile(timing_contract.resolve(), preserved_contract)
    shutil.copyfile(area_path, preserved_area)
    shutil.copyfile(formal_path, preserved_formal)
    shutil.copyfile(tool_metadata.resolve(), preserved_tool)
    shutil.copy2(executable, preserved_binary)
    preserved_binary.chmod(preserved_binary.stat().st_mode | 0o111)
    if sha256_file(preserved_binary) != tool["binary_sha256"]:
        raise TimingEvidenceError("preserved OpenSTA binary digest changed during copying")

    results = [
        _run_analysis(
            analysis=analysis,
            contract=contract,
            output=output,
            executable=preserved_binary,
            timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds,
        )
        for analysis in analyses
    ]
    manifest = {
        "schema": "hephaestus.opensta-abc-sweep-timing-evidence.v1",
        "evidence_level": "opensta_sdc_pre_layout_timing_estimate",
        "source": {
            "abc_area_delay_evidence": preserved_area.name,
            "abc_area_delay_evidence_sha256": sha256_file(preserved_area),
            "abc_area_delay_formal_evidence": preserved_formal.name,
            "abc_area_delay_formal_evidence_sha256": sha256_file(preserved_formal),
        },
        "technology": {
            "technology_id": technology_id,
            "configuration": {
                "path": preserved_technology.relative_to(output).as_posix(),
                "sha256": sha256_file(preserved_technology),
            },
            "liberty": {
                "path": preserved_liberty.relative_to(output).as_posix(),
                "sha256": sha256_file(preserved_liberty),
            },
        },
        "tool": {
            **tool,
            "metadata_artifact": {
                "path": preserved_tool.relative_to(output).as_posix(),
                "sha256": sha256_file(preserved_tool),
            },
            "binary_artifact": {
                "path": preserved_binary.relative_to(output).as_posix(),
                "sha256": sha256_file(preserved_binary),
            },
        },
        "timing_contract": contract,
        "scope": {
            "source_sweep_runs": formal["scope"]["source_sweep_runs"],
            "unique_formally_proved_netlists_timed": len(results),
            "timing_reuse_rule": "only byte-identical mapped-Verilog SHA-256 digests",
            "combinational": True,
            "sequential_depth": 0,
            "parasitics_annotated": False,
        },
        "results": results,
        "comparisons_to_shared_dag": _comparisons(results),
        "claims": {
            "abc_area_delay_source_evidence_verified": True,
            "abc_area_delay_formal_source_evidence_verified": True,
            "all_timed_netlists_formally_equivalent": True,
            "all_unique_formally_proved_netlists_timed": True,
            "opensta_binary_built_from_pinned_source": True,
            "opensta_binary_provenance_captured": True,
            "opensta_binary_reproducibility_verified": bool(
                tool.get("binary_reproducibility_verified", False)
            ),
            "sdc_constraints_applied": True,
            "setup_checks_passed": True,
            "detailed_max_path_reported": True,
            "unconstrained_paths_found": False,
            "pre_layout_timing_analyzed": True,
            "repeatability_verified": True,
            "signoff_sta_performed": False,
            "timing_closed": False,
            "parasitics_annotated": False,
            "placement_performed": False,
            "routing_performed": False,
            "power_estimated": False,
            "post_layout_pex_verified": False,
            "silicon_verified": False,
        },
    }
    write_json(output / "timing_evidence.json", manifest)
    _write_summary(output / "SUMMARY.md", manifest)
    return manifest


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Time every distinct formally proved ABC-mapped netlist with OpenSTA."
    )
    parser.add_argument("area_delay_bundle", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--area-delay-formal", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--contract", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--tool-metadata", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=Path("build/opensta-timing"))
    parser.add_argument("--sta", default="sta")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=300)
    return parser


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    arguments = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        manifest = build_timing_evidence(
            arguments.area_delay_bundle,
            arguments.area_delay_formal,
            arguments.contract,
            arguments.tool_metadata,
            arguments.out,
            sta=arguments.sta,
            timeout_seconds=arguments.timeout,
        )
    except (
        TimingEvidenceError,
        OSError,
        subprocess.SubprocessError,
        ValueError,
    ) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print(
        f"timed {manifest['scope']['unique_formally_proved_netlists_timed']} "
        f"formally proved netlists at evidence level {manifest['evidence_level']}"
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
